result.reason: The redline makes the cap mutual and adopts the greater-of formulation with a USD 1,000,000 floor, but it uses an event-based rather than claim-based lookback. It omits the mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion and the payment-obligations clarification. Although “Excluded Claims” are stated to be uncapped, no supplied operative definition connects that term to any required carve-out; the non-operative margin comment cannot cure the omission. Consequently, neither position is complete, and the redline is not minimal as defined because it does not reach a complete preferred or fallback level.
